tldr: Neptune in the 1st house: longing becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Neptune in the 1st house, this part of you sensitizes identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Neptune describes longing, imagination, sensitivity, compassion, confusion, and the places where boundaries soften. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Neptune can become empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence.
gift: empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
